text: This report recommends approval of the application to amend Official Plan Amendment 650 (By-law Number 476-2023) and Site-Specific By-law 478-2023 to permit a 32-storey (105 metres, plus 7.5 metres for the mechanical penthouse) residential building. The proposal includes a total of 517 residential dwelling units and a two-level underground parking garage with 142 parking spaces, including 25 visitor parking spaces. The applicant has indicated that the proposed tenure of the building will be rental housing. Two short-term parking spaces are dedicated to pick-up and drop-off at grade. A related Rental Housing Demolition application was previously approved as the proposal includes the demolition of 8 residential dwelling units, 2 of which are rental (File Number 21 252355 NNY 17 RH).
